scope: Club Arena player rakeback page, service validation, durable recovery, and account-session isolation

requirements: Real authenticated fn_get_captured_rakeback capability endpoint reviewed and deployed before this page can publish.
Explicit coordinated payer/funding/Union cutover witness before source_active:true; captured facts alone are not activation.
Legacy fn_claim_rakeback must refuse with 55000 at cutover; no mutation fallback once captured activation has been observed.
No bootstrap getter merely to publish this candidate early.
release_gate.missing_getter_behavior: Claims fail closed; previously recorded history remains readable. This is why independent publication is blocked.

rpc_contract.read_activation: Strict boolean source_active and source_final:false; inactive response has no captured periods.
rpc_contract.scope: New requests cover all captured clubs with p_club_id:null; recovery reuses the immutable saved actor and club scope.
rpc_contract.receipt: Strict matching request UUID; safe whole cents; unique normalized period UUIDs; sum(new_payout) equals total_payout and positive period count equals periods_claimed; normalized refusals remain explicit zero-paid deferrals.

behavior: Only captured pending_amount drives Unpaid Rakeback; legacy history and estimates are never added to captured earnings.
Pending whole cents do not promise funding availability. Fractions and unresolved periods remain visible; authoritative deferrals remain unpaid.
One durable, versioned localStorage record per account/request UUID is written and reread before any source mutation; ambiguous responses retain it across refresh.
Recover Claim remains available at zero pending or while the availability read fails.
Only validated authoritative receipt completion clears the matching UUID. Browser cleanup failures are distinguished from an unconfirmed payment.
Account and render-session fences suppress old loads, claims, messages, and bus events, including A-to-B-to-A during a pending claim.
UTC Monday-through-Sunday period validation and date display; duplicate club/week rows rejected.

validation.final_build_provenance: d6a032d8 behind-main=0 DIRTY by=local; generated before candidate commit
validation.final_build_sentry_uploads: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN explicitly empty; no plugin upload ran.
validation.limits: Real page, hook, and service execute under the React DOM test harness with controlled RPC responses and the repository storage shim. This is not a live account payout, a native database proof, or full programme completion.

independent_review.verdict: SQL/API browser contract approved as an isolated checkpoint; funding/cutover remain separate release blockers.
independent_review.last_followup: Generic deferred copy and render-session return race changed after API approval; no SQL ABI change.

wiring.route: src/App.tsx lazy-loads and renders RakebackPage at the existing route.
wiring.page: RakebackPage calls useRakeback; existing visibility, rakeback-period realtime, balance, and settlement refresh hooks remain.
wiring.hook: useRakeback calls the read/claim/storage service and emits RAKEBACK_CLAIMED only for current-account validated positive payouts.
wiring.service: Only server RPCs can mutate money; no client amount is supplied.

observations.initial_local_build: The first normal local build used existing configured Sentry integration and successfully uploaded maps. Parent was notified. No credentials were read or changed. Final verification disabled external uploads.
